items.content_html: A lightweight Node.js automation that generates and emails a nightly summary of Brevo transactional email activity. It runs on GitHub Actions, queries the Brevo API for messages sent during a rolling 10:00 PM–10:00 PM America/Denver reporting window, groups activity by email subject or template, and sends a formatted report through SMTP.
